source_title: Hearts fan views on 2-2 draw with Rangers - BBC
source_excerpt:
We asked for your views after injury-hit Hearts were denied victory over Rangers by an 89th-minute equaliser on Derek McInnes' return to Tynecastle.
Jim: A great display by Hearts, the players gave their all and were unlucky not to get all three points. Great fighting spirit, roll on Sunday.
John: I'm proud of the fight and passion the boys showed against Rangers. There were positives to take from the performance and you can see the effort and desire is there. But at the same time, it's frustrating because we need to be more clinical in front of goal and cut out the mistakes at the back. These are the games where the fine margins matter, and we can't afford to switch off.
George: Hearts dominating Rangers is no great surprise, we now have a much better coach and were lucky McInnes left.
Jay: It would have been nice to have a come-from-behind win, but given our injury list is as long as the Royal Mile, players having to play out of position all over the park, and other results, I'll take that. Keep fighting lads!
Grahame: Gutted. Rangers sneak a draw with help from the referee. We get into great positions and then constantly fluff our lines. Game was there for the taking and we only have ourselves (and the referee) to blame.
Liam: With all our issues in terms of injuries and playing every three days I'd have taken a draw against a Rangers team that cost tens of millions to put together. The reality is Rangers sneaked out the back door with a point in their bag. Now on to Hibs where no complacency will be tolerated.
